title: METHOD-00 - Bridge Discipline
claim: The Theophysics method tests structural correspondence by auditing borrowed foundations, mapping structure rather than vocabulary, modeling only what survives mapping, and verifying before rhetoric.
assumptions: Cross-domain claims need a repeatable bridge discipline.
The same evidence should be evaluated under symmetric register standards.
definitions: Map: preserve roles, order, constraints, failure modes, and boundary conditions.
Model: define dynamics only after a mapping survives.
Verify: test with proof, data, adversarial review, kill conditions, and register labels.
bridges: Wilsonian RG / effective field theory is a guarded bridge for the article workflow, not a claim that Theophysics is literally QFT.
negative_guards: Do not let analogy pass as proof.
Do not cite Lean without a build receipt.
Do not smuggle theology into physics-register claims.
Do not smuggle physics into theology-register claims.
kill_conditions: Bridge claims depend on forced relabeling.
The method cannot demote favorite claims.
Physics claims exceed what physics actually says.
Theology appears inside the formal grammar layer.

ledger.meaning: Source claim ingested into Lane 4 ledger.
